artworks.label: Beeswax Walnut Mouse
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for wickling-hollow. One tiny original woodland mouse curled peacefully inside a half walnut shell, the entire little sculpture carved from warm honey-gold beeswax. Mouse has two round delicate ears, tiny closed sleeping eyes and a long fine tail curled along the shell rim; mouse anatomy readable as a mouse, no wings. The walnut shell has deeply carved natural grooves and sits in one curled oak leaf also made of golden beeswax. Exquisite soft translucent wax, fine hand-carved fur impressions, tiny pinprick warm amber glow within the shell as though softly lit from inside, a cozy storybook woodland craft matching a beeswax dragon and lantern-creature collection. No candle flame, extra animals, ground or separate base. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
